tasks.short: Collaborate to develop and revise kindergarten programs

steps.what: Review current kindergarten programs and relevant evaluation evidence
Collaborate with teachers and administrators to evaluate and choose program revisions
Write the revised kindergarten program and supporting activity outlines
Check revised program content and the version to circulate
Circulate the checked program revision to participating staff

tasks.design: Use the current program structure in {DOCS} and direct links to evidence in {LMS}. Separate collaborative decisions, actual program writing and the final staff circulation; software reuses unchanged sections without choosing educational revisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current version and reconstructing unchanged program structure repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document structure and version links can preserve usable existing content.
tasks.still_hard: Program suitability depends on varied pupil needs and practical staff experience.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate educational choices and resolve different professional views.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time reconstructing program documents.

reach.learn: Make the chosen changes traceable to evaluation evidence

evidence.claim: Native document reuse can reduce repeated structure and retrieval without automating educational judgement.

assumptions: The revised program is the task's existing deliverable read by teachers and administrators. No additional meeting record or change log is introduced.

The teacher verifies current program version and evidence dates in s1, produces revision choices in s2 and captures them in s3. All capture is included in 24 retained writing hours; missing links are resolved manually.

Version links remove 1 of 10 retrieval hours. Reusing unchanged sections and activity-outline structure removes 6 of 30 writing hours; new pedagogical content stays human. No model text generation or implied machine fill is named.
Ordinary same-system author saves need no approval. The separate final-version check supports the actual staff circulation.
unknowns: Whether current versions are consistently identified
research_questions: Does document reuse remove the specified reconstruction work without stale program content?

already_counted.description: Write actual program changes and check the circulation version

incremental.description: Maintain program structure and evidence links

approvals.approved_version: Exact revised program version and staff recipient list checked in s4; content or recipient changes invalidate the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=93, gross 7 less 1 upkeep gives 6 net. Substantial curriculum changes retaining all retrieval and 29 writing hours leave one hour removed, offset by upkeep. Comparable program sections retaining 9.5 retrieval and 25.5 writing hours, other 60 and 1 upkeep yield 4 net. Collaboration, content checking and actual circulation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, schedule and conduct balanced classroom activities with staff

steps.what: Review staff availability, student needs and existing activity resources
Confer with staff to choose balanced instruction, demonstration and investigation activities
Write the activity plan and schedule in the existing staff planning format
Send the final activity plan and schedule to participating staff
Conduct planned activities while supporting students to observe, question and investigate

tasks.design: Use native availability views in {CALENDAR} and the existing activity-plan structure in {DOCS}. Keep staff discussion, plan writing, internal communication and classroom delivery as separate work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated availability navigation and planning headings consume a small coordination share.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar views and an existing plan layout can remove those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Activity balance and support must respond to the children on the day.
tasks.human_edge: Enable investigation while keeping participation accessible.
tasks.altitude: Make agreed activity arrangements easier to write and use.

reach.learn: Use the final arrangements and raise support conflicts

evidence.claim: Native availability views and plan layouts can reduce repeated handling; no local time saving has been measured.

assumptions: The activity plan and schedule already guide participating staff. No extra lesson transcript or completion log is introduced.

The teacher verifies staff availability and current support constraints in s1 and captures chosen activity, time, staff and resource details in s3. Capture is counted; unavailable or conflicting calendar data is checked manually with staff in s2.
The availability view removes 1 of 10 preparation hours. Existing plan headings and repeated time-block layout remove 3 of 20 writing hours; activity selection and support content remain human.
No automatic booking or calendar invitation is implied. Actual staff sending is s4, and ordinary author saves in s3 remain retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Current plan layout and calendar coverage
research_questions: Does layout and availability reuse reduce coordination work after resolving support conflicts?

already_counted.description: Capture and check final activity details

approvals.approved_version: Exact checked plan and schedule from s3 and verified staff recipient set; changes require rechecking
Exact current instruction and activity delivered to participating students; changed support needs or activity content require teacher reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=96, gross 4 less 0.5 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Missing calendar coverage retains all preparation and 19.5 writing hours, with upkeep offsetting the half-hour removed. Compatible time blocks retaining 9.5 preparation and 18 writing hours plus other 70 and 0.5 upkeep give 2 net. Meetings, actual staff communication and classroom delivery remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardized ability and achievement tests with appropriate support

steps.what: Check standardized test instructions, pupil identity and permitted accommodations
Administer standardized ability and achievement tests to kindergarten students
Capture pupil responses and administration conditions in the authorized test record
Check response completeness and document any departures from the testing procedure

tasks.design: Use a direct reference to the current authorized test manual in {DOCS} and its permitted administration-record format. The teacher administers the test and captures actual responses; reuse only stable identity and setup context where the instrument permits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual navigation and repeated administration metadata add handling around direct testing.
tasks.enabler_now: Authorized document links and record fields can reduce those operations without altering the instrument.
tasks.still_hard: Accommodations and response interpretation must preserve valid administration.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the child needs support or the administration is no longer valid.
tasks.altitude: Reduce administration metadata handling while preserving test validity.

reach.learn: Read actual conditions and deviations before interpreting results

evidence.claim: Authorized manual links and stable administration metadata reuse can reduce handling; test-specific permission and time effects remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Response and condition capture is intrinsic to administering the standardized test, not a new activity log. Scoring and educational placement decisions are separate tasks and no automatic marking is introduced.

The teacher verifies pupil identifier, test version, date and permitted accommodation in s1 and captures responses and actual conditions in s3-s4. All capture remains priced; prohibited or unavailable electronic formats fall back to the authorized paper record.
Direct manual links remove 1.5 of 15 setup hours. Permitted reuse of identity and test-version context removes 2.5 of 25 recording hours; item responses and observations stay fully human.
Ordinary same-system saves have no approval stage. No send, scoring engine or result transfer is implied.
unknowns: Instrument permission for electronic record reuse
research_questions: Does authorized metadata reuse reduce handling without changing administration validity?

already_counted.description: Capture actual responses and check administration conditions

incremental.description: Keep the current authorized manual link and form version

approvals.approved_version: Exact test version, pupil, accommodations and administration procedure checked in s1; changed setup requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=96, gross 4 less 0.5 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Paper-only instruments retaining all setup and 24.5 capture hours have their half-hour saving offset by upkeep. An authorized reusable record retaining 14 setup and 23.5 capture hours plus other 60 and 0.5 upkeep yields 2 net. Test delivery and validity checks remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct and monitor safe use and care of equipment

steps.what: Check equipment condition and the students' immediate support needs
Instruct students in safe use and care of equipment and materials
Monitor actual equipment use and intervene to prevent injuries or damage

tasks.design: Retain physical checks, demonstrations and immediate supervision. A reusable instruction sheet in {DOCS} does not replace showing and monitoring safe use by these children.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task's work occurs during physical equipment use.
tasks.enabler_now: No identified software operation removes that supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Hazards emerge as children handle materials.
tasks.human_edge: Intervene immediately and adapt instruction to the child.

reach.learn: Recognize when direct intervention is required

evidence.claim: Physical demonstration and active supervision remain human work without an identified record-handling saving.

assumptions: This task is safe-use instruction and supervision. It does not require a routine record after every equipment interaction; no such record is added.
The teacher produces condition and support assessments in s1 and observes actual use in s3, with all capture time retained. No machine consumes an assumed safe/unsafe flag.

No routine lookup or written artifact is identified in this task; native templates and views remove none of the priced demonstration or supervision. Incident documentation is only required when an actual incident occurs, not invented here.
No new system or periodic upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether any equipment has a routinely required checklist
research_questions: Is there a real current lookup or checklist operation inside this task beyond direct supervision?

already_counted.description: Check conditions and monitor safe use

approvals.approved_version: Exact safe-use demonstration to the present students using the checked equipment; changed equipment or needs require reconsideration
Exact current supervision instruction or intervention for observed use; changed hazards require immediate teacher judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=100 and no upkeep gives zero. Familiar materials and unfamiliar equipment both retain physical checking, demonstration and active monitoring; no actual repeat record operation is specified for removal.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep classroom collaboration, assessment delivery and physical supervision human while reducing existing planning-document repetition.
reach: Make program changes usable for teaching staff
Keep test conditions explicit for specialists
skills_to_grow: Separate plan writing from staff discussion and sharing
role.ambitious_version: A special education teacher with clearer shared plans and reliable administration records while retaining direct teaching and supervision.
